integrity: Exact proof. The nonstandard step is an explicit one-point-deletion decomposition of any complete level-2 hypertriangulation; the remaining extremal step is Rajan's published ordinary Delaunay min-containment theorem. No numerical experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite generic planar point sets with at least four points; competitors are complete level-2 hypertriangulations. No uniqueness, incomplete-competitor, or level-k-for-k-at-least-3 claim is made.
title: Order-2 Delaunay minimizes maximum enclosing-circle radius
